opening.argument: The offer starts with a €580 OneCoin package, connects its tokens to mining, and projects a €64,950 valuation. Recruitment is presented as financially rewarded through participant investments and bonuses within a binary and unilevel structure that pays through multiple levels. Framing the purchase as education and an opportunity to build the coin does not resolve the scam concern: paid participation is promoted through projected value and recruitment rewards. The price is an expectation, not a documented realized return, and company-controlled mining and exchange form part of the model.
